home.title: Nordgate — Your route into the Nordics
home.description: Nordgate helps established international companies enter, sell and grow across the Nordics through local market knowledge and hands-on commercial execution.

services.title: Nordic Market Entry
services.description: Build your Nordic market before you build a Nordic office. Nordgate assesses, targets and executes Nordic sales on behalf of established international companies.

approach.title: How It Works
approach.description: The Nordgate process, from market assessment to onboarding, outreach execution and continuous market feedback.

about.title: About
about.description: Nordgate is a commercial bridge between the Nordic region and Eastern Europe. Our purpose, the team behind it and where we operate.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Nordgate helps Nordic companies access vetted international service providers and operational capacity, selected, vetted and coordinated on your behalf.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Perspectives on Nordic market entry, sales and cross-border business development from Nordgate.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Let's find out whether the Nordics make sense for your business. Get in touch with Nordgate to discuss market entry.

offer.title: Market entry, built around you.
offer.body: We help B2B companies understand the Nordic opportunity before committing to it — then run the commercial work that turns it into real conversations.
offer.imageAlt: A panel discussion in a chandelier-lit hall at a Nordgate-connected business event
offer.validationBody: We test real demand in the Nordics before you commit resources.
offer.gtmBody: We define the positioning and commercial model that fits how Nordic buyers decide.
offer.buyersBody: We build the shortlist of accounts, buyers and partners worth approaching first.
offer.bizdevBody: We run follow-up and qualification so interest turns into commercial traction.

problem.title: Ambition is rarely the problem.
problem.body: Companies stall in the Nordics because they lack what only comes from being on the ground: context, relationships and an honest read of the market.
problem.pointOne: Buying decisions rarely work the way a plan written elsewhere assumes.
problem.pointTwo: Hires and infrastructure get built before anyone has proven demand.
problem.pointThree: Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland each decide at their own pace.
problem.imageAlt: A panel discussion in a chandelier-lit hall at a Nordgate-connected business event

humanStory.title: Nordgate started with a simple observation.
humanStory.body: Working across European business ecosystems, we kept seeing capable companies struggle to turn international interest into real opportunities. Nordgate was created to close that gap.
humanStory.quote: Expansion works better when someone helps open the right doors.
humanStory.imageAlt: Samuel and Anders, Co-Founders of Nordgate

cta.title: Ready to test the Nordic opportunity?
cta.body: Tell us where you want to grow. We'll help assess the opportunity, identify the right market and define how Nordgate can execute the commercial work.
cta.imageAlt: A laptop displaying a photograph from a Nordgate-connected business event

process.title: From first conversation to live outreach.
process.stage1Body: Align on the product, existing customers and lessons from international sales.
process.stage2Body: Assess Nordic markets and identify the strongest commercial opportunity.
process.stage3Body: Define the ideal customer, priority accounts and relevant decision-makers.
process.stage4Body: Build positioning, messaging and locally adapted outreach sequences.
process.stage5Body: Launch calls, email and LinkedIn outreach to book qualified meetings.
process.stage6Body: Use real market feedback to improve targeting, messaging and follow-up.

services.heroTitle: Build the market before the office.
services.heroBody: Validate and grow in the Nordics without standing up a local team on day one.
services.whoBody: We work best with businesses that already know how to sell. They just don't yet know how to sell in the Nordics.
services.notFitBody: If you're still validating product-market fit at home, that work needs to happen before Nordic expansion.
services.fit1: A proven offering with existing customers
services.fit2: Commercial traction in your home market
services.fit3: Capacity to deliver on new business
services.localTitle: Four markets, four ways of deciding.
services.localBody: Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland each have their own commercial culture and buying rhythm. Treating them as one market is where most entries stall.
services.localImageAlt: A speaker addressing an audience at a Nordgate-connected business event
services.phasesBody: Insight defines where to play. Setup builds the infrastructure. Execution turns it into meetings.
services.insightBody: Find where the opportunity actually is, before committing resources.
services.setupBody: Build the commercial infrastructure before outreach begins.
services.executionBody: We run the selling, not just the planning.
services.execution1: Cold calling, email and LinkedIn outreach
services.sprintBody: A fixed-scope engagement to test whether the Nordics are worth pursuing, before any larger commitment.

approach.heroBody: A single accountable team, not a report handed over at the end of a project.
approach.imageAlt: An audience filling a red-seated auditorium at a Nordgate-connected industry event
approach.outreachBody: Every qualified meeting feeds market feedback back into targeting and messaging.
approach.splitTitle: What you bring. What we run.

approach.client4: Fast decisions on pricing and positioning
approach.nordgate2: ICP, target account list and messaging
approach.nordgate3: Direct outreach across calls, email and LinkedIn
approach.nordgate4: Qualified meetings and ongoing account development

about.heroBody: We connect companies, capabilities and opportunities across the Nordics and international markets.
about.whyBody: Nordgate is a commercial execution partner, not only an advisory firm. We simplify cross-border growth through local market knowledge, trusted relationships and practical commercial work — and that distinction shapes how we scope every engagement.
about.teamTitle: A team built for cross-border growth
about.imageAlt: An audience filling a red-seated auditorium at a Nordgate-connected industry event
about.whereTitle: Local presence, not a distant HQ.
about.whereBody: From Copenhagen, Stockholm and Skopje we work across chamber networks, companies, decision-makers, agencies and service providers on both sides of the gateway.
about.principle1Body: Every Nordic market has its own culture and decision-making pace. We treat them as distinct.
about.principle2Body: We use our networks commercially, connecting the right people rather than listing contacts.
about.principle3Body: Even where partners are involved, Nordgate stays the single commercial contact.
about.principle4Body: We prioritise the right accounts over volume, so growth stays sustainable.

capabilities.heroTitle: Capacity, without a new vendor hunt.
capabilities.heroBody: For Nordic companies: we identify, vet and coordinate international providers and operational capacity on your behalf.
capabilities.cat1Body: Software development capacity and technical specialists.
capabilities.cat4Body: Market research, content and campaign execution.
capabilities.notMarketTitle: A coordination layer, not a directory.
capabilities.notMarketBody: Directories hand you a list and leave the evaluation to you. We stay involved — shortlisting, supporting the decision and remaining your single point of contact.
capabilities.notMarketImageAlt: A panel discussion in a chandelier-lit hall at a Nordgate-connected business event
capabilities.howBody: You bring the requirement. We handle the search, the evaluation and the coordination that follows.
capabilities.step1Body: We clarify scope, constraints and success criteria.
capabilities.step2Body: We propose vetted partners and assess competence and references.
capabilities.step3Body: We help you compare and select with confidence.
capabilities.step4Body: We coordinate onboarding and the cooperation that follows.
capabilities.criterion4: Cultural compatibility with Nordic working practices
